releaseNotes: feat: Implement panel grouping and enhance diagnostics display
changelog: Added `PanelGroups` data model to manage panel connections by grouping.
Introduced `listLabel` and `accountName` functions for better display of panel information.
Updated `DiagnosticsScreen`, `ServerListScreen`, and `SetupCredentialsScreen` to utilize new grouping features.
Created `PanelDetailScreen` for detailed management of panel groups and API keys.
Added unit tests for panel grouping logic and utility functions.
